Avoid eating here, so many cockroaches, the staff seemed totally fine with squashing them behind our table and giggli
Jan 2023
I honestly couldn't believe how bad the service was, we were the only table seated and until my partner went to ask staff to order no one approached the table. As we waited for food a cockroache ran across the table. I've lived in developing countries and do understand how hard it can be to keep them out of a premise preparing food in a tourist srea. However when the owner appeared with a huge can of pesticide and began spraying while a waitress stomped on cockroaches behind our table it really felt too much. 

If the pest problem is that bad you really shouldn't be serving the public, please avoid this place it's dirty and genuinely filled with cockroaches.

Such a disappointment after reading positive reviews, so many other genuinely great began places to eat please avoid this place. They clearly have no respect for customers or cleanliness.

Nice food
Dec 2019 • Family
The food was good here. The lemongrass tofu was very tasty. The service is a bit slow and the waiter could often be seen sitting around whilst we were waiting for our order to be taken. It wasn’t the cheapest but it was not too expensive like some other vegetarian restaurants in HCM. If you’re passing by and you need a veggie/vegan meal, this place is good. The English here isn’t the best (not their fault at all, we’re in their country) so just be prepared to have to clarify things.

Good food but inattentive staff
Dec 2019 • Friends
The vegan food at this restaurant is really good and probably deserves 4/5 (especially the mushroom dishes, so tasty!) and the place is pretty quiet so food comes quickly, but the staff at this restaurant are so rude and inattentive! It really ruined the meal for us. I can’t speak for the staff on the first floor, but the waiting staff on the top floor were completely uninterested in customers and just sat in a little room at the back of the restaurant so it was difficult to get their attention. Go for the food, just don’t expect particularly good service.
